product_boundary: Business-management system with case-specific document management; no top-level daily template workflow

information_architecture.safety_rule: The selected company, process, petition number, bench, and risk state remain visible throughout case work

visual_system.tone: quiet authority, dependable case-file indexing, high information density without card clutter

interaction_rules: Company selection precedes operational case work
Document generation is available only inside a selected case
Archive instead of permanent delete for operational records
Show status text in addition to color
Use visible labels, focus indicators, loading states, errors, confirmations, and success notifications
Use compact tables for repeatable operational records and clear empty states
responsive_rules: Fixed 248px desktop rail and compact 72px tablet rail
Single-column forms and record layouts on narrow screens
Keep the selected-case header visible above module navigation
regulatory_ui: Model deadlines must display their provision, calculated date, status, override reason, and legal-review limitation
